profile.summary: ashsearle is a senior-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in date/time library development, specializing in Moment.js. Their contributions focus on core date/time logic, TypeScript integration, edge-case handling (floating-point precision, DST transitions), and internationalization. The developer demonstrates strong debugging skills, backward compatibility awareness, and API design improvements. Their work is narrowly focused on library maintenance rather than application development, with a particular emphasis on precision arithmetic, timezone handling, and locale-aware formatting.
